violations.text: The hand-washing sink in the kitchen was blocked by boxes. A hand-washing sink shall be accessible at all times for employee use. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/25/2026

The chlorine sanitizer concentration for the sanitizing cycle of the dishwasher was 0 parts per million (ppm). Chlorine sanitizing solutions must be between 50-100 ppm. Establishment to use 3 bay sink to sanitize all glassware and utensils. Unit to be adjusted. Service report to be sent to inspector. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/25/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (ice machine) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Ice machine was taken out of service and emptied during the time of inspection. Establishment is to send evidence of correction to inspector once completed. New Violation. Correct By: 08/25/2025
